text:
kayla: FYI — onboarding sampleapp produced duplicate DB inserts when a 429 hit during token refresh. Not a user-facing error but doubled a few rows in staging  :grimace:

sam: ouch. do you have logs or a repro?

kayla: repro steps in thread: start sampleapp -> trigger burst of embed calls (100 concurrent) -> auth token rotates in the middle -> some requests get 429 then retried by our client lib. saw same request id twice in app logs.

ingrid: can you paste the retry config from the sampleapp? curious if it's using immediate retries or our SDK safe-replay guard is disabled.

kayla: snippet: ```js
// sampleapp config
retries: 3,
baseBackoffMs: 100,
jitter: 0, // oops
enableSafeReplay: false,
```

sam: ahhh jitter: 0 + token rotation can align retries and cause double side-effects. also safeReplay disabled — that combo explains exact dupes.

maya: action: add recommended jitter and re-enable safe replay in onboarding template. also surface a warning in the quickstart if token rotation is enabled.

kayla: agree. quick experimental numbers: setting jitter to uniform(100,500) dropped duplicates to 0/1000 in a local run.

alex: for SDK parity: make sure go/python/node defaults match. currently node default had enableSafeReplay false in sampleapp only. i'll file parity ticket.

ingrid: proposed default change for sampleapps and quickstart: retries: 4, baseBackoffMs: 150, jitter: 100-600, enableSafeReplay: true. Also add example header usage: ```http
POST /v1/generate
Idempotency-Key: <uuid-v4>
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

sam: +1. add a short note about not using user-visible side-effects in auto-retries (idempotency keys for charge-like ops).

kayla: i'll update the sampleapp PR with the config + a test that simulates token rotation + 429s. leaning to adding a small telemetry flag so onboarding detects unsafe configs and warns: "Retry settings may cause duplicate side effects". thoughts?

maya: love the telemetry warning. make it opt-out for private deployments.

devbot: Deploy check: ensure sampleapp quickstart change has docs update, SDK parity ticket, and a small e2e test in CI. PR checklist created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/1234 :white_check_mark:

alex: i'll own the parity ticket. kayla, ping me on the PR and i'll review the test logic.

kayla: thanks all — updating now. will post results in this thread when CI finishes. :thumbsup:
